release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $35.0m beat the company's flat-to-slightly-up guide and the $34.53m FXEmpire consensus, and the FY guide was narrowed to $142-146m with the low end held, so the feared second cut did not come; offset by a $16m quarterly cash drop and a lower year-end cash outlook (~$70m vs ~$80m), EPS -$0.46 vs -$0.44, against a 10% short near cash value.
